read: BOHO is +0.64 $/gal; D4 x 1.5 = 2.97, so RINs cover the soybean oil premium to heating oil by 2.33 $/gal before 45Z and LCFS.
D4 trades +0.148 over D6: a wide spread says biomass-based diesel, not ethanol, is the marginal RIN.
Best screen margin: Domestic UCO renewable diesel at +2.99 $/gal into California; weakest: Imported UCO renewable diesel at +1.49 $/gal outside it.
Highest breakeven D4 is Imported UCO renewable diesel at 1.10 vs D4 at 1.98: even the marginal pathway runs at screen prices.

Mandate: D4 generation through 2026-10 runs at 8.31 bn RINs a year vs a 9.07 bn biomass-based diesel obligation (-0.76 bn); the rest of the year needs 1.07 bn a month vs 0.69 so far, so the RIN has to keep paying for more gallons (or carryover RINs get drawn).
Soybean oil biodiesel: +2.39 $/gal with 45Z of 0.49; breakeven D4 0.39.
